description: Baseline and later matching comparison for only brilliant_scientist_krg_fabricate_portal_transit_batch. Scenarios declare deterministic KRG fields, source flags, the teleportation family id (7), and the existing exact candidate. This is a single-candidate willingness-score audit, not a global AI selection pool. No random seed, uncertain input, scheduled state change, event MTTH, custom pool cadence, or time distribution is claimed. Patch-specific receipt, quote-source, discount-expiry, and native reservation-order semantics are named but explicitly unresolved until the parent's final source reveals exact authority tokens and field mapping.
